mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1%) signals persistent stagflation risk, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings pressure and valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances meeting the trigger condition (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a housing starts decline (HOUST < 1200) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing retail sales and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with HOUST < 1200 during late-cycle expansion (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with INDPRO < 100 (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPI index values above 244.0 signal elevated inflation, prompting market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 244.0 (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment decline (PAYEMS < 145000) signals labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with PAYEMS < 145000 (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS < 470000) signal broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances meeting both trigger conditions (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
